(2) The scene shifts to her standing in a sleek, modern clinic lobby with product shelves; she wears a black and white off-the-shoulder outfit and gestures toward a medical device labeled CLASSYS Ultraformer III. (3) Inside a consultation room, she sits across from a male doctor, gesturing to her jawline and cheeks while explaining her concerns. (4) The doctor, a middle-aged man in a white lab coat and blue surgical mask, uses hand gestures to explain the treatment process as the camera focuses on their interaction. (5) The woman lies on a treatment table with white grid markings on her cheeks as the doctor applies a hand-held medical applicator to her skin. (6) She makes exaggerated, pained facial expressions for comedic effect during the procedure while lying on the bed. (7) Returning to the initial indoor setting, she speaks to the camera about her one-month progress, using hand gestures to frame her face. (8) Split-screen comparisons show her side profile and frontal view before and after the treatment. (9) She concludes by holding her hands out toward the camera while announcing a promotion.
